rust_summary: `native_menu_button_v2`: a mod container's menu button with the clicking player's cursor stack (`clickMenuButton(Player, int)`).
doc_summary: `native_menu_button_v2`: a mod container's menu button (`AbstractContainerMenu.clickMenuButton(Player, int)`) with the clicking player's cursor stack, read and written, so a widget outside the slots can take or give what the player carries (a tank taking a bucket). It fires right after `native_menu_button`, on the server, for single player and LAN guests alike. Bundles need "hooks": @API:menu_button_v2@.
